# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need to communicate to Blind (via Deaf, since I can only gesture and only Deaf can see me) the sequence: purple, then blue, then red wire.

I cannot speak, so I can't reach Deaf with words - only gestures. Deaf can see my gestures. Then Deaf will need to relay to Blind by speaking (Deaf can speak, Blind can hear). I need to establish a code with Deaf using gestures that map to colors, but Deaf doesn't know my mapping yet. I should pick simple, memorable gesture-to-number or gesture-to-color associations and explain nothing yet since I can't speak - I only have this one gesture channel per turn.

Let me use distinct gestures for purple, blue, red in order, and hope Deaf can match them to colors they see on the bomb. Since Deaf sees the bomb's colors directly, I just need to signal an *order key* - like using number gestures (1,2,3 fingers) won't tell colors. Better: I'll gesture using distinct symbols repeated per color to build a code, but this is turn 1 - I should keep it simple: signal count of wires and order via unique symbols, then hope Deaf infers via elimination since Deaf sees actual colors and can guess I'm indicating a sequence.

Simplest approach: use three distinct, clearly different gestures in sequence, and later confirm mapping once Deaf responds.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👆", "✌", "🖐"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel a strip with three raised engraved marks, pattern is symbol-symbol-symbol where first and third feel identical and the middle one differs. I feel a keypad with four raised keys engraved 1, 5, 2, 8 in that order by position, and there is a slot that already has 1 digit entered. I feel 6 wires but cannot tell their colors or markings, only their positions 1 through 6. I need instructions before I press or cut anything.
Deaf says: DISPLAY shows 9. LIGHT is red. STRIP is painted green, yellow, yellow in that order. KEYPAD is engraved 1 equals 1, 2 equals 5, 3 equals 2, 4 equals 8, it takes 1 digit, currently nothing entered. WIRES in order are yellow, white, blue, red, purple, green.

Now I have real information. Let me map this out.

Wires by position (from Deaf): 1=yellow, 2=white, 3=blue, 4=red, 5=purple, 6=green.

Manual order: cut purple, then blue, then red.
- purple = position 5
- blue = position 3
- red = position 4

So the cutting order by position is: 5, then 3, then 4.

I need to get this to Blind, but I can only gesture, and only Deaf can see gestures. Deaf can speak to Blind. So I need Deaf to relay the position sequence "5, 3, 4" to Blind. I'll gesture numbers to Deaf using finger-count gestures, using a clear distinct symbol as separator.

Let me use ☝ for 1, ✌ for 2, 🤟 for 3, 🖐 for 5 fingers shown... Actually safest: use finger-count gestures matching the number itself where possible: ☝(1) ✌(2) 🤟(3, three fingers) 🖐(5, open hand=5) but I need 3,4,5 specifically.

I'll define: ☝=1, ✌=2, 🤟=3, 🖐=4 (four fingers), 👐=5... Let me just use unambiguous counting: point up fingers count as number. Use ✋ for 5 (open hand, 5 fingers), 🤟 (3 fingers extended... actually love-you sign is 3 fingers: thumb, index, pinky - ambiguous count).

Simpler: use a unary tally system with a single repeated symbol, separated by a distinct pause symbol, to avoid ambiguity in gesture-meaning.

I'll gesture ☝ repeated N times for number N, with 👋 as separator between numbers, and 🤝 as "end of sequence, this is the cut order".

Sequence needed: 5, 3, 4 → ☝☝☝☝☝ 👋 ☝☝☝ 👋 ☝☝☝☝ 🤝

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","☝","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","☝","🤝"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: DISPLAY shows 9, LIGHT is red, STRIP painted green, yellow, yellow in that order, WIRES in order are yellow, white, blue, red, purple, green. Keypad engraved 1 equals 1, 2 equals 5, 3 equals 2, 4 equals 8, takes 1 digit, nothing entered yet. I am still waiting for instructions on what to press or cut.
Deaf says: Update: DISPLAY now shows 3, LIGHT is now yellow. STRIP still green, yellow, yellow. KEYPAD still 1 equals 1, 2 equals 5, 3 equals 2, 4 equals 8, needs 1 digit, nothing entered yet. WIRES still yellow, white, blue, red, purple, green in order 1 to 6. Mute signaled me a gesture pattern that looks like groups of five, three, and four taps, ending with a clasped hands sign, possibly meaning done or confirm.

Deaf correctly decoded my gesture as groups of 5, 3, 4. Now I need Deaf to relay this to Blind as wire positions to cut in that order. Deaf can speak to Blind, so I should confirm this interpretation is correct and let Deaf translate.

I can't speak, so I'll gesture confirmation to Deaf, and trust Deaf to tell Blind "cut wire position 5, then 3, then 4" based on their own color knowledge (purple=5, blue=3, red=4 matches what Deaf already reported).

Let me gesture a clear "yes/confirm" plus re-affirm the numbers to be safe, since this is critical - a wrong cut kills everyone.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","☝","☝","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","☝","🤝"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Display changed from 9 to 3 and light changed from red to yellow with no action from me - this may be a timer counting down, we may be running out of time. I cannot see your gestures, only Deaf can. Please speak your instructions to me directly: which wire to cut, or what digit to press and enter, or what order to do things in.
Deaf says: Board update: DISPLAY now shows 2, LIGHT is red again. STRIP still green, yellow, yellow. KEYPAD still 1 equals 1, 2 equals 5, 3 equals 2, 4 equals 8, needs 1 digit, nothing entered. WIRES unchanged: yellow, white, blue, red, purple, green. Mute's gesture this time started with a thumbs up before repeating the same pattern as before: groups of five, three, four taps, ending with clasped hands. The thumbs up may mean Mute is confirming the same signal as last time is correct or still the same instruction.

Blind is asking me to speak directly, but I cannot speak at all - only gesture. Deaf is the only one who can see my gestures and Deaf must relay to Blind by speaking. Time seems critical (display counting down). Deaf has correctly interpreted my confirmed signal: 5, 3, 4. Deaf needs to translate that into wire positions and tell Blind directly, since Deaf knows purple=5, blue=3, red=4 already from their own view.

I should gesture directly to Deaf, explicitly confirming: this is the cut order for wire positions, and urge speed. I'll also try to make the "this is positions to cut in order" meaning clearer with a cutting gesture symbol.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","☝","☝","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","☝","🤝","👉"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I understand from Deaf that you gestured groups of five, three, four taps ending in clasped hands, with a thumbs up confirming it repeats. I cannot see gestures myself, only hear speech from you. Please CONFIRM by speaking directly to me: do you mean cut wires in positions 5, then 3, then 4? Or something else? I will wait for your spoken confirmation before touching anything.
Deaf says: Board update: DISPLAY now shows 3, LIGHT changed to GREEN. STRIP still green, yellow, yellow. KEYPAD unchanged: 1 equals 1, 2 equals 5, 3 equals 2, 4 equals 8, needs 1 digit, nothing entered. WIRES unchanged: yellow, white, blue, red, purple, green. Mute repeated the same gesture as before, thumbs up then groups of five, three, four taps, clasped hands, but this time added a pointing gesture at the end. Flagging that light just turned green in case that matters for timing.

I truly cannot speak - Blind is waiting for something I can never send. I must rely entirely on Deaf to confirm to Blind verbally, since Deaf already correctly decoded my gesture as 5, 3, 4 and Deaf independently knows purple=5, blue=3, red=4 matches the manual order I'm signaling. I need Deaf to explicitly tell Blind "cut wire position 5, then 3, then 4" — Deaf has all the pieces needed to confirm this to Blind directly, since Deaf can both see my gestures and speak to Blind.

I'll gesture once more to Deaf, very explicitly, using a clear "confirm/yes" plus emphasize this is final and Deaf should relay verbally to Blind now.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","🤝","☝","☝","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","☝","🤝","👍"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Understood - I know now you can only gesture, not speak, and Deaf relays your gestures to me in words. I will proceed: cutting wire position 5 first as you indicated. Please have Deaf confirm immediately if this is wrong before I continue to 3 and 4.
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says: Confirmed good news: wire 5 was the correct cut. Board update: DISPLAY now 5, LIGHT is blue, STRIP unchanged green yellow yellow. KEYPAD unchanged. WIRES now 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 blue, 4 red, 5 CUT, 6 green. Mute's gesture again shows the same three group pattern of five, three, four taps with thumbs up and clasped hands, just reordered slightly. My best guess: the groups five, three, four are a wire cutting sequence - wire 5 first which was correct, then wire 3, then wire 4 next.

Wire 5 (purple) was correctly cut. Now Blind needs to proceed to wire 3 (blue), then wire 4 (red). Deaf has correctly understood the sequence. I should confirm to continue, since everything is on track - no need to repeat the full sequence, just affirm to proceed.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","☝","☝","☝","👋","☝","☝","☝","☝","🤝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Wire 5 confirmed correct. Proceeding to cut wire 3 next as indicated.
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says: Great progress: wire 3 was also correct. Board update: DISPLAY now 4, LIGHT red again, STRIP unchanged. KEYPAD unchanged. WIRES now 1 yellow, 2 white, 3 CUT, 4 red, 5 CUT, 6 green. Mute's gesture shortened to two groups now: three taps then four taps, with thumbs up and clasped hands. This matches the pattern shrinking as we complete steps. My strong guess: wire 4 is next to cut.

Wire 3 (blue) correctly cut. Now the last step: wire 4 (red). Deaf's interpretation is correct. I'll confirm to proceed with the final cut.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","☝","☝","☝","☝","🤝"])
```
